versions.content: {DRAFT} When LdCom_TpRxIndication is invoked, LdCom shall use the passed PDU Id as Handle Id (LdComHandleId ECUC_LdCom_00005 ) to derive the corresponding <LdComUser_LdComTpRxIndication> user notification callback and call it with the according LdCom user callback handle Id.
